subject: design/feature-implementation-drive
statement: Review state is observed but never equated with completion. `open`, `changes-requested`, `approved-but-unmerged`, and `merged-unverified` all leave the task and every dependent incomplete. For a proposal to complete a task, the reconciler must verify: its reviewed head is the current proposal head; its base is the feature branch; required checks/reviews bind that head; the code host reports a landed revision for the merge/squash/rebase result; and that landed revision is an ancestor of the freshly fetched feature-branch head (`design-brainstorm:feature-implementation-drive-tech-design#D-3`).
